title: GuardaPrevenção
description: GuardiaoPlugin is a complete protection and management solution designed for Paper and Purpur 1.21+ servers.
body:
🛡️ GuardaPrevenção

GuardaPrevenção is a complete server protection and utility plugin designed exclusively for Paper and Purpur 1.21+ servers. Combining anti-lag systems, interactive restriction controls, suspension management, and PlaceholderAPI support, it gives administrators powerful tools to keep their servers stable, secure, and well-managed.

Built with efficiency and performance in mind, GuardaPrevenção provides everything needed to prevent abuse, reduce lag, and improve staff moderation—all within a single lightweight plugin.

⚡ Anti-Lag Module

Protect your server from performance issues before they become a problem.

Features
Automatic ground item cleanup based on configurable limits.
Emergency build-lock system for critical situations.
Projectile optimization that removes arrows and tridents after impact.
Real-time server monitoring panel.
Commands
Command	Description
/sistemas travar	Enables emergency construction restrictions
/sistemas liberar	Disables emergency restrictions
/sistemas limpar	Performs manual ground cleanup
/glimpar confirmar	Executes cleanup with confirmation and server broadcast
/gstatus	Displays TPS, RAM usage, player count, entities, and chunks
🔒 GTravar — Interactive Restriction System

Manage potentially harmful mechanics through a modern GUI.

Main Command
/gtravar

Opens a fully interactive 6×9 inventory interface with sounds, decorative elements, and instant toggles.

Restrictable Mechanics
Lava Buckets
Water Buckets
Flint and Steel
TNT
End Crystals
Wither Summoning
Sponges
Redstone Components
Repeaters
Comparators
Pistons
Observers
Hoppers
Droppers
Vehicles
Slime Blocks
Honey Blocks
Signs
Books
Fireworks
Beacons
Bedrock
Command Blocks
Respawn Anchors
Additional Features
Staff notifications when blocked items are used.
Immunity system for trusted players.
Configuration reload support.
Real-time updates.
Performance
Built-in 30-second authorization cache.
Reduces repeated permission checks.
Minimal impact on server performance.
🚫 GProibir — Suspension System

A complete moderation module focused on temporary suspensions.

Staff Commands
Command	Description
/gproibir <player> <days>	Suspend a player for a number of days
/gproibir <player> <days> [reason]	Suspend with a custom reason
/gproibir reset <player>	Remove a suspension
/gproibir info <player>	View punishment details
/gproibir resetbv global	Reset cinematic welcomes globally
Player Command
Command	Description
/gminhapunicao	View your own punishment information
🎬 Suspension Features
Adventure Mode enforcement while suspended.
Prevents gamemode bypass attempts.
Automatic expiration of suspensions.
Persistent punishment records saved in YAML.
Cinematic welcome sequences.
Sequential messages with sounds.
Screen titles such as:

SUSPENDED

and

FORGIVEN

to provide a professional moderation experience.

🎯 PlaceholderAPI Support

Integrate GuardaPrevenção with scoreboards, TAB lists, holograms, and other plugins.

Available Placeholders
Placeholder	Output
%guardiao_suspenso%	true or false
%guardiao_status%	Suspended or Free
%guardiao_tempo_restante%	Remaining punishment time
%guardiao_motivo%	Punishment reason
%guardiao_dias_originais%	Original suspension duration
%guardiao_badge%	Colored [SUSPENDED] badge
%guardiao_prefixo_punicao%	Punishment prefix with remaining time

Example:

%guardiao_badge% %player_name%
🔑 Permissions
Permission	Description	Default
guardiao.admin	Full access to all modules	OP
guardiao.gtravar	Access to GTravar	OP
guardiao.gproibir	Access to GProibir	OP
guardiao.limpar	Use /glimpar	OP
guardiao.status	Access /gstatus	OP
guardiao.bypass	Immune to restrictions	OP
guardiao.notify	Receive GTravar alerts	OP
guardiao.punicao.ver	Allows players to view their own punishment	Everyone
📁 Configuration Files

All files are automatically generated after the first startup:

plugins/GuardaPrevencao/
├── config.yml
├── guardiao.yml
├── gtravar.yml
└── gproibir.yml

This structure keeps every module organized and easy to configure.

🚀 Built for Modern Servers

GuardaPrevenção was developed to deliver powerful protection without sacrificing performance.

Highlights
✅ Paper & Purpur 1.21+ compatible
✅ Lightweight and optimized
✅ Designed for servers with 50+ players
✅ No external database required
✅ YAML-based persistence
✅ PlaceholderAPI support
✅ Staff-focused management tools
✅ Interactive GUI controls
Why Choose GuardaPrevenção?

GuardaPrevenção combines anti-lag optimization, restriction management, and advanced moderation into a single plugin. Instead of relying on multiple plugins to protect and maintain your server, you get one efficient solution built for modern Minecraft communities.

Whether you're running a survival server, a public network, or a growing community, GuardaPrevenção helps you prevent abuse, reduce lag, and keep your server under control with confidence.
